snippet.title: POSSUM BOY!, a Romantic Comedy VN, Coming Soon to itch.io!
snippet.description:
Big Knife presents "How am I supposed to fit in at college when there aren't any other animal people but I'm a POSSUM BOY!: The Ballad of Joey Virginia," a romantic comedy visual novel about being the only animal person around! Featuring tons of awesome artwork by Laurel Neal, a bunch of original music by Matt Martin, six different cuties to potentially date, and even a mysterious secret ending! Coming soon to itch at https://big-knife-games.itch.io/possum-boy.

Trailer voice over by Sam Gabriel
